generations.reroll_reason: first base art height under spec (normal foe target ~44 art px; boss ~92 like the stand-in); redraw larger with the first pick as identity reference
generations.prompt: Sootwing, a small soot bat monster for a JRPG side-view battle, flying, facing right. Round chibi charcoal-brown head-body, one big white eye with dark pupil, small glowing ember-orange beak pointing right, two wide dark soot bat-membrane wings spread with ember-orange tips and ember trailing edges, ash-grey rim light. Hovering mid-flap. Large sprite that fills most of the canvas. Clean readable pixel art sprite with dark outline, single creature centred, transparent background.
idle flying loop: flaps its bat wings up and down while hovering in place
dive attack: pulls its wings back and rises, then dives forward and down to the right beak first, then flaps back up to its place
casting an ash puff: hovers and beats its wings hard, a cloud of grey ash and small embers puffs out in front of it, then it keeps hovering
taking a hit: knocked backwards to the left, wings crumple, eye squeezes shut, then it flaps to steady itself
death: stops flapping, wings fold, it falls tumbling downward and crumbles into grey ash flakes and fading embers until nothing is left
